/corecraft/play-lands/azure-space.html.description: Azure Space is a space-themed multi play station from our CoreCraft Play Lands range, finished in Sky Blue and Knight Blue. Several towers are linked by a bridge, and a tube slide brings children down from the upper deck. Children climb up, cross over, hang from the bars and swing, and the listed capacity is 15 at a time. The age group starts at 3 years and key users are 3 to 12, so one structure covers both the younger and older children of a housing society. The product area is 33'11" x 28'8" and the safe play area is 39'11" x 34'8". Azure Space is covered by our 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Send us your site plan and we will check whether it fits.
/corecraft/play-lands/azure-space.html.spec_paragraph: Posts and frames are galvanised pipe, and the slides and panels are roto-moulded, so neither rusts in the monsoon. We install it self-standing or by grouting, depending on your ground. Lay rubber flooring or another impact-absorbing surface over the full 39'11" x 34'8" safe play area. Check bridge fixings, swing hardware and rope parts at regular intervals.

/corecraft/play-lands/coral-cascade.html.description: Coral Cascade is built around a central tower, with climbing arms reaching out on each side. Children get up by the rock wall or the net climbers, hang from the frame and come back down through the tube slides. The age group starts at 5 years and key users are 5 to 12, so the climbs are pitched at school-age children rather than toddlers. It suits a primary school ground or a society whose children have outgrown smaller play units. Up to 15 children can use it at once. It comes in Play Orange and Royal Turquoise. The product area is 29'8" x 26'1" and the safe play area is 34'8" x 32'1". We give a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask for a layout drawing for your ground.
/corecraft/play-lands/coral-cascade.html.spec_paragraph: The tower and climbing arms stand on galvanised steel posts, and the tube slides are roto-moulded. Installation is self-standing or grouted once we know your soil. With net and rock climbing on several sides, the whole 34'8" x 32'1" safe play area needs an impact-absorbing surface. Inspect net ropes and climbing holds for wear during maintenance.

/corecraft/play-lands/fun-field.html.description: Fun Field is the second largest structure in our Play Lands range, with a product area of 44'10" x 42'9". It carries a jungle theme in Lemon Yellow and Sea Green, and several towers are joined by tunnels, each with its own slide. Children climb, crawl through, hang and slide without everyone queuing at one point, which matters on a busy evening in a park. With an age group of 3+ and key users from 3 to 12, it suits municipal gardens, large townships and resorts with open ground. The listed capacity is 15 children. Plan for a safe play area of 50'10" x 49'9". Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope on Fun Field come with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Share a site photo and we will plan the layout.
/corecraft/play-lands/fun-field.html.spec_paragraph: Our team installs Fun Field on site from galvanised posts, decks and roto-moulded slide and tunnel sections. We fix it by grouting or as a self-standing unit, based on the ground. The photos show it on a circular safety surface, and we can supply rubber flooring for the full 50'10" x 49'9" zone. Check tunnel joints and deck bolts at each service.

/corecraft/play-lands/giants-galore.html.description: Giants Galore is the largest unit in Play Lands, covering 54'5" x 47'1" before the safe zone is added. An octopus figure sits among Play Red and Baby Blue towers, and striped slides radiate out from the centre along with tube slides and walkways. Children climb up, balance along the walkways, hang from the bars and pick from several slides on the way down. The age group is 3+ with key users from 3 to 12. At this size it makes a centrepiece for a large public park, township or resort lawn rather than a society corner. The safe play area is 59'5" x 53'1" and the listed capacity is 15. Every galvanised pipe, roto-moulded part, composite laminate and length of play rope in it is warranted for 3 years. Call us to discuss whether your ground can take it.
/corecraft/play-lands/giants-galore.html.spec_paragraph: Walkways, towers and slides sit on a galvanised steel frame, with roto-moulded slide beds and figures. We choose grouting or a self-standing base after a site check. Mark the full 59'5" x 53'1" safe area on your plan before work starts and keep footpaths outside it. Walkways and their joints need a regular check for loose bolts.

/corecraft/play-lands/gloden-hour.html.description: Gloden Hour is a long, narrow play station in Play Orange and Play Yellow, measuring 39'4" x 20'9". That shape lets it run along a boundary wall or beside a podium garden where a square unit would not fit. Canopy towers shade the decks, a rock wall offers a way up and a tube slide brings children back down. Swinging is part of the activity list too. It is listed for ages 3+, with key users from 3 to 12 and a capacity of 15. Keep a safe play area of 45'4" x 25'9" around it. We cover galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope under a 3-year warranty. Send us your plot dimensions for a layout.
/corecraft/play-lands/gloden-hour.html.spec_paragraph: Canopies, slides and panels are roto-moulded and fixed to galvanised steel posts that resist rust. We install it self-standing or grouted. Because the unit is long, check that the 45'4" x 25'9" safe zone does not overlap a path or a parking lane. Routine maintenance should cover the swing fittings, canopy bolts and rock wall holds.

/corecraft/play-lands/joy-ridge.html.description: On Joy Ridge, a row of linked platforms runs across 45'9" x 34'6", joined by bridges and a net tunnel. Slides shaped like octopus legs come down from the decks beside tube slides, all in Play Orange and Lavender Dilly. Children spend much of their time moving between towers, crawling the net tunnel and hanging from bars before they choose a slide. Key users are 3 to 12 years and the age group starts at 3. That spread works for a school that shares one play area between pre-primary and primary classes. Listed capacity is 15 and the safe play area is 50'9" x 39'6". Its pipes, moulded parts, laminates and play rope carry 3 years of warranty cover. Once you share your site size, we can send a layout drawing.
/corecraft/play-lands/joy-ridge.html.spec_paragraph: Platforms and bridges are carried on galvanised steel posts, with roto-moulded slides and play rope in the net tunnel. Installation is grouted or self-standing to suit the soil. Lay an impact-absorbing surface across the 50'9" x 39'6" area. Look over the net tunnel ropes and the bridge links for wear at regular intervals.

/corecraft/play-lands/play-pulse.html.description: Play Pulse comes in a multi colour finish, which keeps it bright on a plain lawn or a grey podium. Its towers are joined by linked decks, with climbing nets to get up and tube slides to come down. The footprint is close to square at 39'6" x 38'5", so it sits well in the middle of a park or society play area with paths on all sides. Children climb, slide and hang across the decks. The age group is 3+ and key users are 3 to 12, with a listed capacity of 15. The safe play area is 45'6" x 43'5". If you want particular colours, we can discuss our roto-moulded shade options. We warrant the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope for 3 years. Ask us for a quote and a drawing for your site.
/corecraft/play-lands/play-pulse.html.spec_paragraph: The structure stands on galvanised steel posts, with roto-moulded tube slides and rope climbing nets. We fix it by grouting or as a self-standing unit. Because children can enter from every side, keep the full 45'6" x 43'5" zone surfaced and free of benches. Check net tension and slide joints during routine maintenance.

/corecraft/play-lands/thrill-trail.html.description: Mushroom-shaped canopies top the towers of Thrill Trail, finished in Crazy Pink and Sand Beige. Bridges link the towers, a rock wall gives children a harder way up and the slides bring everyone down. A swing set is attached to the structure, so swinging happens alongside climbing and hanging. Key users are 3 to 12 years, with the age group starting at 3. It covers 45'9" x 33'8" and needs a safe play area of 50'9" x 39'8", and the listed capacity is 15. The softer colours suit a resort lawn or a residential project that wants something other than the usual red and blue. The 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope used in Thrill Trail. Ask us for a layout.
/corecraft/play-lands/thrill-trail.html.spec_paragraph: Galvanised posts carry the towers, bridges and swing beam, and the canopies and slides are roto-moulded. Our installers fix it self-standing or grouted, whichever your ground allows. Swings need clear space in front and behind, so mark that within the 50'9" x 39'8" zone. Check swing hangers, seats and canopy fixings at each service visit.

/corecraft/play-lands/tiny-tot.html.description: Tiny Tot is the Play Lands unit for younger children, with key users from 3 to 9 years. Children walk up steps instead of a steep climb, and the deck under a hexagonal roof leads to three slides, including a tube slide and an open slide. Activities are kept to climbing and sliding, which is what children of this age go back to again and again. It comes in Royal Turquoise and Play Yellow. The product area is 31'9" x 24'11" and the safe play area is 37'9" x 30'11". It suits pre-schools, day care centres and the toddler corner of a housing society. The listed capacity is 15. For 3 years, our warranty covers manufacturing defects in its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Tell us how many children use the space and we will plan around it.
/corecraft/play-lands/tiny-tot.html.spec_paragraph: Galvanised posts hold the deck and hexagonal roof, and all three slides are roto-moulded, so they stay rust-free outdoors. Depending on the soil, we put it on a self-standing base or grout it in. Young children need soft ground wherever they step off, so surface the whole 37'9" x 30'11" area with rubber flooring. Check step treads and slide edges during regular maintenance.

/corecraft/play-lands/we-wonderland.html.description: We Wonderland has a carousel-style canopy in Crazy Pink and Play Yellow, which gives it a fairground look. Under it are slides, a bridge, a climbing panel and a swing, all within 29'8" x 15'1", the smallest product area in our Play Lands range. That narrow footprint fits a society garden, a school courtyard or a restaurant play corner. Key users are 3 to 9 years and the age group starts at 3, so it is pitched at younger children. The safe play area is 35'8" x 21'1" and the listed capacity is 15. Warranty cover runs for 3 years on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share the size of your space and we will send a layout drawing.
/corecraft/play-lands/we-wonderland.html.spec_paragraph: The frame is galvanised steel and the canopy, slides and panels are roto-moulded. Fixing is by grouting or a self-standing base, decided at the layout stage. The photos show it on a circular safety surface, and we can supply rubber flooring for the 35'8" x 21'1" zone. Leave room in front of and behind the swing, and check canopy bolts at every service.

/corecraft/robo-romp/dual-bot.html.description: Dual Bot is a compact robot-themed play station from our Robo Romp series, with a robot-head canopy over the main deck and two slides coming off it. It comes in three colour pairs: Play Red and Baby Blue, Mango Yellow and Knight Blue, or Play Orange and Sea Green. The age group is 5+ and key users are 5 to 12, so it suits primary schools and societies with school-going children. Children climb to the deck and slide down, and the listed capacity is 15. The product area is 23'7" x 18'6". Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope on Dual Bot are warranted for 3 years. Tell us which colour pair you prefer and we will send a quote with a layout.
/corecraft/robo-romp/dual-bot.html.spec_paragraph: Posts and railings are galvanised steel, and the canopy and slides are roto-moulded. Installation is self-standing or grouted, chosen after we see the ground. Keep a 29'7" x 23'6" safe play area with impact-absorbing flooring and give the slide exits extra room. Check railing joints and slide fixings during routine maintenance.
